faq_1_q: How long will it take to get my website ready?
faq_1_a: Speed is our priority: a launch site is usually live within 5 to 7 days. Larger projects take 2 to 4 weeks, with partial deliveries so you can always see the progress.
faq_2_a: For mutual security and commitment, we start with a 50% deposit. The remaining balance is paid once the project is completed and meets your full satisfaction.
faq_3_q: Why do I need the continuous care service?
faq_3_a: A website is like a physical store: it needs maintenance and security. We handle backups, speed optimization, and protection so you never lose a customer.
